articles.description: A running collection of practical engineering notes — grounded in how we design, build, and ship reliable systems.

items.title: Designing firmware that survives power loss
items.summary: How we structure embedded firmware around transactional state so a system can lose power at any instant and still recover to a known, safe state.

items.title: Structured logging beyond the console
items.summary: Why machine-readable, correlated logs scale better than human-readable output when diagnosing distributed systems in production.

items.title: Grounding model output: retrieval before generation
items.summary: A practical look at retrieval-augmented generation and why grounding an answer in documents you control beats hoping for a memorized one.

items.title: Measuring real-world performance, not benchmarks
items.summary: Why we instrument the critical path of production systems and view performance as a property of the running system rather than a lab number.

items.title: Interrupt latency and deterministic systems
items.summary: How careful interrupt design and bounded response times let embedded systems meet strict timing guarantees under real load.

items.title: Edge inference for constrained hardware
items.summary: A guide to running inference on devices with limited compute and memory, and the trade-offs that shape where a model is deployed.

hero.description: We engineer firmware and hardware-aware software for microcontrollers, FPGAs, and edge devices — where reliability and latency matter more than anything else.

whatWeBuild.title: The intelligence embedded in real-world hardware.
whatWeBuild.lede: We design firmware and embedded software that runs reliably on real silicon — deterministic, resource-conscious, and built to the physical limits of the device.
whatWeBuild.desc: From bare-metal firmware to real-time operating systems and edge deployments, we own the full stack of the device. Requirements, schematics, firmware, integration, and on-device validation.

capabilities.description: Embedded engineering is the discipline of perfect behavior under tight constraints. Every capability is grounded in how hardware really behaves.

deterministic.title: Deterministic Behavior
deterministic.desc: Predictable timing, bounded latency, and scheduling that meets real-time guarantees — analyzed before the board ships.

closeToHardware.title: Close-to-Hardware
closeToHardware.desc: Register-level interaction, memory-mapped I/O, and a precise model of how the device actually executes instructions.

protocols.title: Communication Protocols
protocols.desc: Wired and wireless interfaces — MQTT, BLE, LoRaWAN, Modbus, and more — implemented with exact semantics and handling.

drivers.title: Device Drivers
drivers.desc: BSPs and low-level drivers written against the datasheet, with clean interfaces for the application layer above.

resourceConstrained.title: Resource-Constrained
resourceConstrained.desc: Memory budgets, flash budgets, and power budgets negotiated explicitly. Software that respects the silicon it runs on.

hardwareBoundaries.title: Hardware/Software Boundaries
hardwareBoundaries.desc: Clear ownership of the interface between firmware and the rest of the system — stable, documented, testable.

stack.description: A focused, proven toolkit for real-time embedded systems. We select controllers, real-time operating systems, and connectivity on engineering merit — not hype.

process.description: A disciplined workflow for embedded systems. Each phase converges the design toward deterministic, validated hardware and firmware.

reliability.description: Embedded software is only as good as its behavior on the device. We validate relentlessly on silicon, not just in simulation.

hardwareInLoop.title: Hardware-in-the-Loop

integrationTest.title: Integration Testing

realDevice.title: Real-Device Testing

hero.description: NODAL is an engineering and technology practice that turns requirements into reliable products. Everything we build starts from the same place: a conviction that precision, measureable quality, and a clear method are what make software, embedded systems, and AI work in the real world.

mission.description: Our mission is to build production technology that performs under real conditions. We ship software, embedded systems, and AI applications that earn trust by working consistently.

precision.title: Precision
precision.desc: We design each system around measurable requirements and verifiable behavior, so the result matches its specification.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.desc: We favour simpler, well-tested designs over clever ones that are hard to keep running in production.

performance.title: Performance
performance.desc: We treat responsiveness and efficiency as engineering deliverables, measured and tuned like any other requirement.

vision.description: We work toward a future where intelligent products are also dependable ones. Technology should be capable without becoming fragile, and useful without becoming opaque.

scalable.title: Scalable

secure.title: Secure
secure.desc: Security treated as an engineering discipline, not an afterthought.

automation.title: Automation
automation.desc: Repetitive work handled by machines so people can focus on decisions that need judgement.

story.lede: We are engineers, first. That shapes how we work, what we build, and how we measure success.
story.desc: From the earliest days, our projects spanned software, embedded hardware, and applied AI. Rather than specialising in one discipline alone, we kept a single engineering culture across all of them: define the problem precisely, keep designs honest, and verify before you declare anything done.

team.description: Our teams work across software engineering, embedded systems, and artificial intelligence. Each discipline has its own depth, but they share the same engineering standards and tools.

software.title: Software

embedded.title: Embedded

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence

integrity.title: Integrity

quality.title: Quality

collaboration.title: Collaboration

architecture.title: Architecture
